scripts.text:
[Guard]
People under ^ff0000level 130^000000
cannot enter this place.
This place is dangerous. Please go back.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
^ff0000130級^000000以下的玩家
無法進入此地。
這裡很危險，請回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is dangerous.
Please come back after you form a
team with other people.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
寶箱巨鱷很危險。
請與其他人組隊後再來。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This place is dangerous. Please go back.
If you dont have any business here, please go back.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
這裡很危險，請回去吧。
如果您沒有要事，請離開。

scripts.text: Why is it so dangerous?
scripts.translation: 為什麼這麼危險？

scripts.text: I'm here to hunt down Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 我來討伐寶箱巨鱷。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Recently, there has been a case
where villagers have disappeared.
After investigating the tracks, 
we found out the giant monster Buwaya
was responsible.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
最近發生了村民失蹤的事件。
經過調查足跡，
我們發現是巨大的魔物寶箱巨鱷
所為。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Soldiers and mercenaries have been dispatched to 
hunt down Buwaya, but were never
completely successful.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
士兵和僱傭兵已被派去
討伐寶箱巨鱷，但從未
完全成功。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is still kidnapping
the villagers to this day.
Please gather some people to get rid of Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
寶箱巨鱷至今仍在綁架
村民。
請召集一些人來消滅寶箱巨鱷。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is still hiding.
Even if you enter now, Buwaya will not come out. 
Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
寶箱巨鱷還在躲藏。
現在進去，寶箱巨鱷也不會出來。
請稍後再來。

scripts.translation:

I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:

我將為^0000ff{0}^000000開啟隧道。
祝你們好運。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This place is dangerous. You cannot enter.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
這裡很危險，您無法進入。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Let me talk with the party leader.
Please call forth the leader.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
讓我與隊伍首領談談。
請召喚首領。

People under ^ff0000level 130^000000
cannot enter this place.

scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
^ff0000130級^000000以下的玩家
無法進入此地。
這裡很危險，請回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Buwaya is still hiding.
Even if you enter now, Buwaya will not come out.
Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
寶箱巨鱷還在躲藏。
現在進去，寶箱巨鱷也不會出來。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Turn back.
scripts.translation: 轉身離開

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, now is not a good time.
Please try again a moment later.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
哦，現在不是好時機。
請稍後再試。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This place is dangerous. Please do not enter.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
這裡很危險，請勿進入。

scripts.text: - Could not enter due to an unidentified force. -
scripts.translation: - 由於不明力量，無法進入。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You must value your life.
It is better to think carefully before you act.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
您必須珍視生命。
行動前最好三思而後行。

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
Buwaya was running around,
and new people got caught.
We will be stuck in here for the rest of our lives.
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的居民]
寶箱巨鱷四處遊蕩，
又有新的人被抓了。
我們要被困在這裡一輩子了。

scripts.text: Get me outta here!!
scripts.translation: 快放我出去！！

scripts.text: Ca...can't escape?
scripts.translation: 難...難道逃不出去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
We don't have enough power to destroy it but Buwaya has a weakness.
Look at the wall over there.
If you knock there, Buywaya will feel pain and spit you out.
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的居民]
我們沒有足夠的力量摧毀它，但寶箱巨鱷有一個弱點。
看那邊的牆。
如果你敲擊那裡，寶箱巨鱷會感到疼痛，然後把你吐出來。

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped People]
Somthing is wrong here...
Have you experienced this before?
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的人們]
這裡有些不對勁...
你以前經歷過這種情況嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
Ahaa! I wish I had a little more power...
I know its weakness...
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的居民]
啊哈！要是我再多點力氣就好了...
我知道它的弱點...

scripts.text: Tell me.
scripts.translation: 告訴我。

scripts.text: Do you really know?
scripts.translation: 你真的知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
Are you sure you can do it...?
Ok, listen carefully,
its weakness is...
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的居民]
你確定你能做到嗎...？
好，仔細聽，
它的弱點是...

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
...behind us on the walls.
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的居民]
...在我們身後的牆上。

scripts.text:
[Kidnapped Residents]
WHAT?!
Are you ignoring me
because I'm captured in here?
scripts.translation:
[被綁架的居民]
什麼？！
你是在因為我被關在這裡
就無視我嗎？

scripts.text: Would like to go out?
scripts.translation: 想要出去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No, I will stay.
scripts.translation: 不，我要留下。
